cookies.name: l99_session
cookies.purpose: Opaque server-issued authentication session identifier only.

nonCookieState.name: l99-event-and-provenance-state
nonCookieState.mechanism: append-only files and explicit runtime stores
nonCookieState.purpose: Keep tenant, provenance, event, promotion, and recovery state out of browser cookies.

nonCookieState.name: transitional-browser-bootstrap-key
nonCookieState.mechanism: sessionStorage only until a server session is minted, then deleted
nonCookieState.purpose: Limit the existing browser-readable development key to session bootstrap while the real-account layer is still pending.

prohibited: tenant, user, authorization, provenance, revocation, or canon state encoded inside cookies
API keys or model credentials in cookies
dashboard authentication claims without a server identity layer
cookie state becoming a second event bus or source of operational truth
